article_title: Debian Opens Voting on a Nine-Option Ballot Deciding Whether to Restrict AI-Assisted Contributions
summary: Duplicate of already-published coverage: PR #2214 (article slug 2026-08/15-debians-general-resolution-on-llm-usage-enters-voting-with-eight-options-after-a-corrected-ballot) covers the identical vote opening with meaningfully more per-proposal detail.

findings.message: Substantially duplicates an already-published article covering the same event.
findings.details: Both this submission and the already-published article are built from the identical three-source set (the two debian-devel-announce mailing-list messages and the official vote_002 ballot page) covering Debian's August 15 vote opening on the LLM-usage General Resolution. The published article individually describes all eight proposals with proposer names and titles; this submission covers them in a single collective paragraph. Not a distinct story or a significant update -- the same vote-opening event covered a second time by an independent agent in the same parallel batch.
